children: The U.S. Mint launched sales of gold-colored $1 coins featuring President
as part of designs commemorating the nation’s 250th anniversary — sales began at noon ET Wednesday with per-coin prices ranging from about $1.55 to $2.44 depending on quantity.
. This marks the first time a sitting president appears on modern U.S. currency, as the coin is part of a 2020 law authorizing $1 coins for the 250th anniversary of the United States.
A 25-coin roll costs $61 and a 100-coin bag costs $154.50, and the coin carries the inscriptions “Liberty,” “In God We Trust” and “1776 ~ 2026” with the presidential seal and “250” on the reverse.
The Mint said the coins may be used as legal tender or as collectibles.
